decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Environment Flood Risk Matrix, Design and Access Statement, 1713/PL.GR.00, 1713/PL.GR.01, 1713/PL.GR.02 - received 28/11/2017. 1713/PL/GR/06, 1713/PL.GR.00, 1713/PL.GR.03, 1713/PL.GR.04, 1713/PL.GR.05 - received 15/01/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 59 Airedale Avenue, W4 2NN.

Condition : 6 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 59 Airedale Avenue, W4 2NN, and not as primary residential accommodation or for business purposes, nor shall any bathroom or kitchen facilities be installed into the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected or allowed to grow within the areas of these splays on land within the approved development site.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to use as garage in association with formation of a vehicular access at the rear of the house
